newsitem.title: USA: Elek-Tek sees more strategic changes.
newsitem.headline: Elek-Tek sees more strategic changes.

text.p: Elek-Tek Inc, which earlier posted a third-quarter profit versus a loss, said it still needs to make more strategic changes to keep profits growing.
Elek-Tek earlier said it earned $314,000, or $0.05 a share, in the third quarter compared to a loss of $187,000, or $0.03 a share, in the same period last year.
The company said the profit, the first in more than a year, validates a restructuring undertaken by its new senior management.

"We are particularly pleased with our third quarter financial results because they were achieved while we were making significant operating changes and investments in technology for our internal operations," said Richard Rodriguez, president and chief executive officer.

"Although we take pride in the early signs of success, we recognize the need to continue making strategic investments and other changes which should yield the long term payback necessary to achieve sustainable profitable growth," he added.
